DESCRIPTION: FIND — `line_pattern = re.compile(...)` in `_apply_fix_to_source` lacks the `re.DOTALL` flag. The `.` character does not match newlines by default. When a model proposes a multi-line code block replacement (which is required for any non-trivial bug fix), the regex fails to match completely.
FOLLOW: Any fix spanning multiple lines will fail to parse and silently fall through. `_apply_fix_to_source` returns `None`, `evaluate_fix` marks the fix as `UNEVALUABLE` (`fix_applied=False`), and valid multi-line fixes are permanently ignored by the evaluation sandbox.

        r"[Ll]ines?\s+(\d+)(?:\s*[-–]\s*(\d+))?:\s*(.+?)\s*->\s*(.+)",
        re.DOTALL
    )
